Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, isolation, defensive/reactive utilities, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating pressure and CC-protection cues, an urgent isolation warning, native-HUD resource auras, default-off Ninja and Scholar action helpers, fail-closed macro assistance, defensive/reactive utilities with optional Guardian team communication, team-visible focus marking, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds two separate default-off exact-CC utilities. After a client-accepted automatic Guardian, optional party communication may issue localized Covering Target Quick Chat for the frozen P-slot, then place Bind2 on that ally and Bind1 on self; occupied or uncertain signs prevent the sequence from starting, Bind2 is confirmed first, and any cleanup is exact per-sign ownership only. On Scholar, one shared held-key generation may use Critical Strategy 29716 only on an exact guarded canonical S1-S5 enemy, ranking trusted positive team pressure before exact HP and otherwise using HP-first; pressure is selection-only, while final validation checks identity, readiness, live Guard, and native reachability. Both paths freeze intent, never mutate targets, and have no alternate action or post-invocation retry. Schema 21 keeps both opt-ins off for new, upgraded, and reset settings; live command/action confirmation remains required.
